author: jramey2016
quote: Why does rockstar hate their fans so much, I don't care about the woke argument, I don't care about FPS, the game at its core is tedious and boring. Every gripe I've had with RDR2 is in this game, except RDR2 can get away with some of the slowness since, duh, its cowboys. This isn't GTA its a boring chore simulator with a lame protagonist. You traded fun for the sake of realism. You have to be midwit IQ to enjoy this. Also F your critic reviews, I would normally give this a 6-7 but this was and obvi scandal
